"""CCP Stop gate. Small, fast (python boots in ~0.2s here; node takes 1.8-8.2s).

Reads the Stop hook payload on stdin. Decides based on $HOME/.ccp/stop-mode:
  off   -> exit 0 silently (turn ends normally)
  ask   -> block once per stop-cap window, telling Claude to ask the user
  exit  -> exit 0 silently (user chose to leave; let the session end)

The ask path uses the standard Stop-hook block contract:
  {"decision": "block", "reason": "..."}
Claude Code caps consecutive Stop blocks at 8 (CLAUDE_CODE_STOP_HOOK_BLOCK_CAP
can raise it); we count our own blocks and yield before the cap so the cap
never truncates the loop in a confusing way.
"""

[![ci](https://github.com/Suydev/ccp/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Suydev/ccp/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

# ccp — Claude Code control plane for Termux

A small, dependency-light supervisor + hook layer that keeps Claude Code
sessions alive under your control: sessions keep running until *you* say
exit, every turn-end can ask what to do next, and crashes auto-recover.

Works with any provider behind Claude Code — it never touches model config,
API keys, or ports. Everything lives in `$CCP_HOME` (default `$HOME/.ccp`).

```
┌──────────────┐  launches        ┌─────────────┐
│ ccp start    │ ─────────▶       │ claude CLI  │
│ (supervisor) │                  └──────┬──────┘
│              │ Stop hook        │ every turn  │
│ loops until  │ ◀────────        ┤ stop_
